proxy.traefik:
# Traefik reference config for speedtest-tracker, generated by the hub from its image.yml.
# Labels for the speedtest-tracker service in your compose file. Traefik's docker provider must reach the speedtest-tracker
# container on a shared network; the entrypoint websecure and the certificate resolver letsencrypt are
# examples from a typical Traefik setup. Replace example.com with your domain. Websockets need nothing extra.
services:
  speedtest-tracker:
    labels:
      - traefik.enable=true
      - traefik.http.services.speedtest-tracker.loadbalancer.server.port=80
      - traefik.http.routers.speedtest-tracker.rule=Host(`speedtest-tracker.example.com`)
      - traefik.http.routers.speedtest-tracker.entrypoints=websecure
      - traefik.http.routers.speedtest-tracker.tls.certresolver=letsencrypt
      - traefik.http.routers.speedtest-tracker.service=speedtest-tracker
      # Authentication: uncomment one; the middleware is defined in your Traefik config.
      # - traefik.http.routers.speedtest-tracker.middlewares=authelia@docker
      # - traefik.http.routers.speedtest-tracker.middlewares=authentik@docker

kubernetes:
# Speedtest-tracker: generated by the hub from https://github.com/linuxserver-playground/docker-speedtest-tracker/blob/main/image.yml
# Storage sizes are placeholders; secrets belong in a Secret, not this ConfigMap.
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: ConfigMap
metadata:
  name: speedtest-tracker-env
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: speedtest-tracker
    app.kubernetes.io/managed-by: linuxserver-hub
data:
  PUID: '1000'
  PGID: '1000'
  TZ: Etc/UTC
  APP_KEY: ''
  APP_URL: ''
  DB_CONNECTION: sqlite
  SPEEDTEST_SCHEDULE: ''
  SPEEDTEST_SERVERS: ''
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: PersistentVolumeClaim
metadata:
  name: speedtest-tracker-config
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: speedtest-tracker
    app.kubernetes.io/managed-by: linuxserver-hub
spec:
  accessModes:
  - ReadWriteOnce
  resources:
    requests:
      storage: 1Gi
---
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: speedtest-tracker
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: speedtest-tracker
    app.kubernetes.io/managed-by: linuxserver-hub
spec:
  replicas: 1
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app.kubernetes.io/name: speedtest-tracker
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app.kubernetes.io/name: speedtest-tracker
        app.kubernetes.io/managed-by: linuxserver-hub
    spec:
      containers:
      - name: speedtest-tracker
        image: ghcr.io/linuxserver-playground/speedtest-tracker:latest
        imagePullPolicy: IfNotPresent
        envFrom:
        - configMapRef:
            name: speedtest-tracker-env
        ports:
        - name: port-80
          containerPort: 80
          protocol: TCP
        volumeMounts:
        - name: speedtest-tracker-config
          mountPath: /config
      volumes:
      - name: speedtest-tracker-config
        persistentVolumeClaim:
          claimName: speedtest-tracker-config
  strategy:
    type: Recreate
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  name: speedtest-tracker
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: speedtest-tracker
    app.kubernetes.io/managed-by: linuxserver-hub
spec:
  selector:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: speedtest-tracker
  ports:
  - name: port-80
    port: 80
    targetPort: 80
    protocol: TCP
quadlet:
# speedtest-tracker.container: generated by the hub from https://github.com/linuxserver-playground/docker-speedtest-tracker/blob/main/image.yml
# Optional parameters are commented out.

[Unit]
Description=Speedtest-tracker (LinuxServer.io)
After=network-online.target
Wants=network-online.target

[Container]
Image=ghcr.io/linuxserver-playground/speedtest-tracker:latest
ContainerName=speedtest-tracker
AutoUpdate=registry
Environment=PUID=1000
Environment=PGID=1000
Environment=TZ=Etc/UTC
Environment=APP_KEY=
Environment=APP_URL=
Environment=DB_CONNECTION=sqlite
Environment=SPEEDTEST_SCHEDULE=
Environment=SPEEDTEST_SERVERS=
# Environment=DB_HOST=
# Environment=DB_PORT=
# Environment=DB_DATABASE=
# Environment=DB_USERNAME=
# Environment=DB_PASSWORD=
# Environment=DISPLAY_TIMEZONE=Etc/UTC
# Environment=PRUNE_RESULTS_OLDER_THAN=0
Volume=/path/to/speedtest-tracker/data:/config:Z
PublishPort=80:80

[Service]
Restart=always
TimeoutStartSec=900

[Install]
WantedBy=default.target
